verdict.rationale: Morph is a model-serving API platform, so offering vision, audio, or image-generation models is a fair question for it. The evidence documents only open-weight text chat models, text classifiers (Reflexes), code editing (Fast Apply), compression, and search, with no mention of vision, audio, or image-generation endpoints.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call vision, audio, or image-generation models beyond text chat on the same platform
